title: Establish stakeholder feedback loop and templates for release notes
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Goal: Create a repeatable stakeholder review loop and two canonical templates (internal engineering release notes and customer-facing changelog) so every release has consistent messaging, signoff traceability, and clear engineering/CS handoffs.

Scope: Draft templates, run two pilot reviews (one minor patch, one feature release), document SLAs for reviews (24-48h), and add a lightweight signoff record in Confluence + link to the release PR. Coordinate with Eng, Design, Security, Legal (if applicable), and Customer Success for content and redaction rules.

Why now: Recent releases had inconsistent public-facing messaging and missed customer-impact flags. This reduces post-release support load and increases trust with customers through predictable, well-reviewed changelogs.
acceptance_criteria:
- Two templates published in Confluence (internal release notes, public changelog)
- Review SLA documented and agreed by Eng/Design/CS/Security
- Pilot reviews completed for a patch and a feature release with feedback logged
- Signoff link/field added to release PR checklist and Console release flow
- Ownership and rotation schedule for the release notes owner established
tasks: Draft initial internal release notes template (Miguel)
Draft public changelog template with plain-language guidance (Aisha)
Share templates with Eng/Design/CS/Sec for feedback (by 2025-02-21)
Run pilot review on runtime-1.18.2 patch (ENG-4833) and capture edge cases
Run pilot review on console-2025.03 beta feature and validate customer messaging
Add signoff metadata fields to release PR template (ENG) and Console release flow (PM/Console)
Create Confluence page with signoff process and archive examples
Train CS on changelog highlights and escalation path
comments: 2025-02-18 | Aisha Patel: Created ticket and initial plan. Reached out to Miguel (assignee) and scheduled kickoff with Eng/Design/CS for 2025-02-19.

2025-02-19 | Miguel Santos: Kickoff notes: agreed on two templates and 48h SLAs for normal reviews. Eng requested a lightweight machine-readable signoff field on PRs so automation can pick it up. Assigned ENG-4833 for PR template change.
2025-02-21 | Priya Nair (Design): Feedback on public changelog -- requested a 'what's new' single-sentence field + screenshot guidance. Provided a mockup link. Marked design action DES-2211.
2025-02-23 | Ravi Patel (Security): Security review flow OK for non-sensitive changes. Suggested a 'sensitive_data' boolean flag to route to SEC-77 when true. Will review final template.

2025-02-25 | Miguel Santos: Pilot 1 (runtime-1.18.2 patch) completed. Found two scenarios where changelog language was too technical; CS suggested customer-friendly phrasing. Logged examples on Confluence and updated public template guidance.

2025-02-27 | Aisha Patel: Ran pilot 2 (console-2025.03 feature). Design approved screenshots section. Engineering added PR signoff field via ENG-4833; console flow update scheduled under Console team. Preparing final templates for signoff on 2025-03-03. Added link to draft Confluence page.
notes_for_engineering: Engineering agreed to add a single-line JSON signoff block to PR descriptions (example: 'release_note_signoff: {owner: "pm-user", status: "pending|approved|blocked", link: "<confluence>"}'). ENG-4833 will implement and add automation to fail release if required signoff is missing for public-facing changes.
next_steps:
- Finalize templates and publish Confluence page (owner: Aisha)
- Get formal signoff from Security + CS by 2025-03-03
- Update PR and Console release templates with signoff metadata (ENG)

postmortem_and_metrics_plan: Measure time-to-first-signoff, percent of releases using public template, and number of post-release CS tickets related to unclear messaging. Reassess after three releases and iterate.
